enumDescriptions.facility_id: Broadcast facility or license ID from a national regulator, prefixed with authority slug (e.g., fcc:73953, ofcom:AL000001). Known prefixes: fcc (US), crtc (Canada), ift (Mexico), ofcom (UK), arcom (France), bnetza/medienanstalt (Germany), acma (Australia), mic (Japan), kcc (South Korea), anatel (Brazil), enacom (Argentina), trai (India)
enumDescriptions.openooh_venue_type: OpenOOH Venue Taxonomy enumeration ID, prefixed with the taxonomy authority and version for unambiguous interchange (for example openooh-1.1:20501 for Retail / Malls / Concourse). Bare or dotted hierarchy values are ambiguous and SHOULD NOT be emitted by new senders.
enumDescriptions.rss_url: RSS feed URL for podcast or content feed
enumDescriptions.screen_id: DOOH screen identifier within a venue
enumDescriptions.station_id: Broadcast station identifier — call sign, station name, or other locally recognized identifier (e.g., WCBS-FM, BBC Radio 4, France Inter, 2GB)

type.title: Property Identifier Types

value.description: The identifier value. For domain type: 'example.com' matches base domain plus www and m subdomains; 'edition.example.com' matches that specific subdomain; '*.example.com' matches ALL subdomains but NOT base domain

property_id.description: Unique identifier for this property (optional). Enables referencing properties by ID instead of repeating full objects.
property_id.title: Property ID

enumDescriptions.ai_assistant: AI-powered conversational interfaces including chatbots, AI assistants, and conversational AI platforms, identified by platform-specific IDs
enumDescriptions.ctv_app: Connected TV applications, identified by platform-specific store IDs
enumDescriptions.desktop_app: Desktop applications (Electron, native, Chromium wrappers), identified by application bundle IDs
enumDescriptions.dooh: Venue-operated digital endpoint networks, including screens and audio players, identified by network/venue IDs
enumDescriptions.linear_tv: Linear television stations and networks, identified by station ID or facility ID
enumDescriptions.mobile_app: Native mobile applications, identified by app store IDs or bundle identifiers
enumDescriptions.podcast: Podcast feeds and episodes, identified by RSS feed URLs or podcast IDs
enumDescriptions.radio: Radio station properties, identified by station ID or facility ID
enumDescriptions.streaming_audio: Digital audio streaming properties, identified by platform-specific IDs
enumDescriptions.website: Web properties accessible via browser, identified by domain

publisher_domain.description: Domain where adagents.json should be checked for authorization validation. Optional in adagents.json (file location implies domain).

supported_channels.description: Advertising channels this property supports (e.g., ['display', 'olv', 'social']). Publishers declare which channels their inventory aligns with. Properties may support multiple channels. See the Media Channel Taxonomy for definitions.

items.description: Standardized advertising media channels describing how buyers allocate budget. Channels are planning abstractions, not technical substrates. See the Media Channel Taxonomy specification for detailed definitions.

enumDescriptions.affiliate: Affiliate networks, comparison sites, and performance-based partnerships
enumDescriptions.ctv: Connected TV and streaming on television screens
enumDescriptions.display: Digital display advertising (banners, native, rich media) across web and app
enumDescriptions.dooh: Digital out-of-home buying context, including inventory on venue-operated screens and audio players
enumDescriptions.email: Email advertising and sponsored newsletter content
enumDescriptions.olv: Online video advertising outside CTV (pre-roll, outstream, in-app video)
enumDescriptions.print: Newspapers, magazines, and other print publications
enumDescriptions.product_placement: Product placement, branded content, and sponsorship integrations
enumDescriptions.retail_media: Retail media networks and commerce marketplaces (Amazon, Walmart, Instacart)
enumDescriptions.search: Search engine advertising and search networks
enumDescriptions.social: Social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, etc.)
enumDescriptions.sponsored_intelligence: Sponsored Intelligence — advertising within AI assistants, AI search, and generative AI experiences via the reversed data flow
enumDescriptions.streaming_audio: Digital audio streaming services (Spotify, Pandora, etc.)
